faq.question: How does the deposit return guarantee work?
faq.answer: Our End of Tenancy clean follows official inventory checklists used by Coventry letting agents. If your landlord or inventory clerk points out any clean-related issue within 48 hours, Kimberley returns to rectify it free of charge.

faq.question: Do you bring your own cleaning equipment & supplies?
faq.answer: Yes! Kimberley brings all commercial vacuums, microfibre cloths, limescale treatments, and eco-friendly sanitising solutions. You do not need to provide anything.

faq.question: Can you accommodate emergency short-notice cleans?
faq.answer: Yes. We frequently fit in urgent clients with last-minute moves or unexpected inspections. Message Kim directly on WhatsApp at 07565 333237 for rapid scheduling.

faq.question: Do I need to be present while you clean?
faq.answer: No. Kim works with complete autonomy. Many clients leave keys in a lockbox or let Kim in before heading to work, receiving a text message 20 minutes before completion.

faq.question: Are you fully insured and registered?
faq.answer: Yes. Krystal Klean Limited is an active UK company (Company No. 11957565) established in 2019, with full £1M+ public liability insurance.
